probe_reason: Multiply PrimaryItem by 1.1 about its geometry AABB center at fixed camera. Predict further enlargement and increased overlap with the block. This tests local scale sensitivity, but all listed causes can worsen under this probe, so it cannot uniquely distinguish them. Centered scaling may also move feet below the floor; that side effect is not evidence of the original cause.
